intro: Choose a language to get started.
privacy: Workspaces and history stay on this device. Connected AI receives only the content you choose to send.
customModelHint: Use a model name from this provider. Its service address and API key are reused. Image input is enabled only for models with verified support.
keyStored: An encrypted key is stored. Leave this blank to use it.
keyPrivacy: Windows encrypts your key for your account.
testNote: The test sends a short text prompt to {provider} and may incur a small API charge.
noKey: No API key is stored for this preset.
readyOffline: You’re in offline mode. Browse projects, check your environment and view local history. You can connect a model anytime in AI Providers.
project: Choose a local project to get started.
finishIntro: Start a conversation or analyze a screenshot from the Assistant.
timeoutNote: Leave blank to use the app’s request limits. Enter 1–120 seconds to set a shorter deadline.
testScope: Connection tests check text responses only. Other capabilities come from the provider's documentation.
configuredTestScope: Connection tests check text responses only. Other capabilities come from provider documentation or saved model settings.
offline: A default model is not configured.
errorTimeout: The provider did not answer in time. Check your connection, then retry.
errorKey: The provider rejected the API key. Use an active key for the selected provider and region.
errorCredential: Windows could not access the stored key. Enter your API key again.
errorNetwork: Asimi could not reach the provider securely. Check your network and the provider’s availability in your region.
errorRate: The provider limited the request. Check your quota or wait a moment before retrying.
errorBalance: The provider reported insufficient balance. Check your account balance, then retry.
errorModel: The provider rejected the selected model. Check its name and your account's model access.
errorUnavailable: The provider could not complete the test. Retry when the service is available.
errorChanged: The provider settings changed during the test. Review the current settings and retry.
errorIncomplete: The provider returned an incomplete response. Retry the connection test.
errorOutcome: The connection dropped before the test result arrived. Check your network and retry.
